## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the missing-results behavior before merge because it allows the release gate to pass without saved checks. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds missing-file fallbacks for saved results and optional display preferences, plus tests for saved checks and preference loading.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Reject releases when the results file is missing — When the results file is absent, `release_allowed(path)` now returns `True`: the fallback returns `[]`, and `all([])` succeeds instead of propagating the missing-file error. — A release with missing results can pass the gate without evidence that any required check succeeded.
